messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-12T02:47:13Z - Elevated throttle_events/sec + rising queue_depth on dedicated-us-east-1 (service=runtime)
ashwin: I got the page. seeing sustained queue_depth and a jump in throttle_events. customers seeing 429s and slow tail latencies.
maria: on it. which pools/variants? any config changes deployed recently?
ashwin: Dedicated pool us-east-1 (pool-C). no deploys in the last hour. looks like one customer sent a large burst of long-context generations. tokens/sec dropped on several shards.
jordan: joining. do we have autoscaler logs? any failed launches?
kelly: pulling logs now. there are instance_launch_errors in AZ-1 around 02:40Z and quota-denied responses from cloud provider. autoscaler attempted to add nodes but was rate-limited.
cloud-support-bot: Cloud ticket created CS-90821 (quotas) - response ETA ~2h.
maria: impact viz: subset of enterprise customers experiencing errors and elevated p95. CS notified. we should mitigate and stop noisy pages.
ashwin: quick mitigations applied: 1) temporary throttle threshold bump on soft alerts 2) enabled small-variant fallback for affected route 3) increased autoscaler aggressive target where possible
jordan: did the scale up actually complete?
kelly: partial. some nodes launched in other AZs but AZ-1 blocked. so queue shuffling started but backpressure remained for shards pinned to AZ-1.
maria: action for oncall: avoid paging for transient spikes while we stabilize, but keep tight visibility. propose changing alerting until quota resolved.
ashwin: proposed alert changes (temporary): - mute queue_depth paging for 40 minutes (annotate incident) - convert queue_depth paging to composite that requires throttle_events high as well - add debounce 120s for queue_depth to ignore sub-2m spikes
jordan: also add a condition to require tokens/sec drop > 25% on shard compared to 15m baseline to avoid pages for bursts.
kelly: I'll put a temporary mute in place: mute-id m-9922 (expires in 40m). Note: muting only prevents page, still logs and creates incidents in dashboard. Annotated: "INC-2026-0312 - temp alert mute"
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0312 created, severity: high, lead: unassigned
maria: assigning @ashwin as incident lead. please capture mitigation steps and ETA for handoff.
ashwin: taking lead. I will stay for 30m then hand to @jordan for monitoring.
ashwin: drafting a composite alert proposal to reduce noise (will add to post-incident tasks):
```
Composite Alert (proposal):
WHEN (avg_over_2m(queue_depth) > 250) AND (rate_over_1m(throttle_events) > 8) AND (percentile_drop(tokens/sec, 5m, baseline_15m) > 25) FOR 3m
OR (customer_error_rate_percent > 0.5 FOR 5m)
THEN page oncall
ELSE create ticket (no page)
```
jordan: +1 to that. also suggest adding a soft-alert for instance_launch_errors so oncall is aware but not paged immediately.
kelly: creating dashboard panel now: https://grafana.redwood/d/zz12/autoscale-summary?orgId=1 . panels: queue_depth (p50/p95), tokens/sec per shard, throttle_events/sec, instance_launch_errors, customer_error_rate.
maria: CS update sent to impacted customers with mitigation steps and ETA for quota resolution.
ashwin: current state: queues decreasing but shard-7 tokens/sec still ~35% low. small-variant fallback reduced customer errors by ~60%.
kelly: cloud support replied, they can provision extra quota in ~1.5-2h if we approve. temporary cross-AZ routing could help but requires routing config change and warmup.
jordan: we should avoid quick config churn. prefer alert tuning + fallback for now. post-incident, add routing fallback runbook.
maria: post-incident action list (add to CONFLUENCE: https://confluence.redwood/INC-2026-0312):
- implement composite alert permanently with tuned thresholds
- add tokens/sec per-shard and percent-drop panels to default oncall dashboard
- increase queue_depth debounce to 120s and use avg_over_2m rather than instant
- add soft alert for instance_launch_errors and failed_scale_events
- document runbook for quota exhaustion and cross-AZ fallback steps
- create RFC for safe temporary min_capacity adjustments for Dedicated pools (requires safety checks)
ashwin: filed follow-ups: INF-7622 (alert tuning + dashboard), INF-7623 (runbook + routing fallback), INF-7624 (min_capacity RFC). assigned owners and ETA 1 week for alert/dashboard work.
ops-bot: @ashwin assigned as incident lead for INC-2026-0312
kelly: saved logs and queries to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/INC-2026-0312/logs-20260312.tar.gz
maria: good work. I'll schedule a 30m post-incident review in #eng-sre-postmortems.
ashwin: handing monitoring to @jordan now. I'll update the incident doc and ensure INF tickets have owners.
jordan: taking over watch for 2 hours. will escalate if tokens/sec doesn't recover or customer_error_rate rises.
cloud-support-bot: CS-90821 updated: quota increase queued, ETA 01:30:00 (approx).
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0312 marked mitigated 2026-03-12T03:47:13Z
maria: closing pages for now. keep an eye and reconvene at postmortem. thanks team.
